hypothesis: Finite solved running keys may finish under literal-F non-consumption even when an ordinary length prefilter rejected them.
rationale: Prior R02 clues.cells requires offset+page_length<=key_length, which is sufficient but not necessary for literal-F. Reuse source-defined offsets only.
novelty: Find finite running-key cells omitted by the old ordinary-length prefilter; enumeration only, no decode or scored reserve inspection.
method: For discovery pages only, necessary bound remaining>=N-count(cipherF); compare old bound remaining>=N. Both signs.
controls: Boundary arithmetic sanity and explicit reserved-page exclusion; feasibility is necessary, not proof beam path exists.
limits: This determines possible cells, not evidence of plaintext or cipher-family likelihood.
next_decision: Add bounded finite-key F search if meaningful omitted cells exist.
